title: India's data law gives you rights, and the rules decide when
sources: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (Act 22 of 2023, 11 August 2023): sections 1(2), 2(i), 2(j), 11-14 (indiacode.nic.in)
DPDP Rules, 2025, notified 13-14 November 2025, phased over 12 and 18 months (PTI via The Week; MirvoLegal timeline as at September 2026)

options: The person the data is about
quiz.why: Right. Section 2(i): any person who, alone or with others, determines the purpose and means of processing personal data.

script: India passed its data protection law in 2023.
India passed its data protection law in twenty twenty-three.
Most of it still isn't in force.
It gives you, the Data Principal, rights:
to access your data, correct or erase it,
seek redress, and nominate someone.
Whoever decides why and how your data is processed
is a Data Fiduciary, and owes you those duties.
But the Act lets the government switch on different parts on different dates.
The rules came in November 2025.
The rules came in November twenty twenty-five.
The Data Protection Board part started at once.
Consent managers come a year later.
Most duties, after 18 months:
Most duties, after eighteen months:
around May 2027.
around May twenty twenty-seven.
The rights are written.
The rules set the clock.
Your turn.
Who is a Data Fiduciary?

claims.claim: The DPDP Act is Act 22 of 2023, dated 11 August 2023
Data Principal: the individual to whom the personal data relates (s. 2(j)); rights to access information (s. 11), correction and erasure (s. 12), grievance redressal (s. 13), nominate (s. 14)
Data Fiduciary: any person who alone or with others determines the purpose and means of processing personal data (s. 2(i))
claims.quote: determines the purpose and means of processing of personal data

claims.claim: Different dates may be appointed for different provisions (s. 1(2))
claims.quote: different dates may be appointed for different provisions

claims.claim: The DPDP Rules were notified in November 2025; Data Protection Board provisions took effect at once
Consent manager provisions take effect one year after notification; most obligations after 18 months, around 13 May 2027

review_note: Act text from indiacode.nic.in. Rules timeline from two secondary sources; the exact commencement dates (13 or 14 Nov 2026 / May 2027) vary by a day across sources, so the script says 'a year later' and 'around May 2027'. Left out: MeitY's January 2026 proposal to compress the 18 months to 12 (a draft, not notified as of the MirvoLegal update in September 2026; re-check before release). 'Most of it still isn't in force' reflects that the rights and fiduciary duties start with the 18-month phase per the timeline sources. Penalties and exemptions not covered.
